dedupe_keys.name: a database of submarine landslides offshore west and southwest iberia

description: A database of submarine landslides offshore West and Southwest Iberia is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Davide Gamboa et al. Submarine landslides are major geohazards occurring on distinct seabed domains ranging from shallow coastal areas to the deeper points of the ocean. The nature and relief of the seabed are key factors influencing the location and size of submarine landslides. Coverage: not stated; published in 2021. Formats: Excel, GeoTIFF, Shapefile, ZIP, PDF. The data are held in OSF and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
